error_message: SelectTrigger exposes technical state values (all, ultimo-mes, cobertura-vacinal) instead of the Portuguese labels required by pg1 and the visible-label acceptance criteria.
root_cause: The selected machine value is passed to Base UI SelectValue without an explicit presentation label. Existing dashboard tests assert the technical values, masking the visual/runtime defect.
prevention_rule: Separate controlled option values from trigger presentation labels; tests must assert user-visible labels and state transitions independently.

findings.error_message: Indicator cards render status icons as their primary icons instead of the stable indicator/domain icons shown in pg1.
findings.root_cause: STATUS_ICONS is keyed only by verde/amarelo/vermelho; indicator identity is never used for icon selection.
findings.expected_change: Add stable indicator-specific iconography while retaining visible/textual status semantics required by SPEC.

findings.error_message: pg1 omits the page title/introduction that TASK-031 requires in production.
findings.root_cause: Pencil frame starts at Filter Bar while src/app/page.tsx correctly renders required title and period introduction.
findings.expected_change: Designer adds the approved block to pg1; do not remove source content unless TASK-031 is formally revised.

findings.error_message: Active header item uses rounded-md on the link and implicit line-height, diverging from the pg1 underline geometry and active-item vertical metrics.
findings.root_cause: Active underline is implemented as a full Link border with rounded corners rather than a compact, near-square underline geometry.
findings.expected_change: Align radius/underline and explicitly set line-height while preserving 44px target, focus and aria-current.

findings.error_message: Pencil footer contains obsolete promotional copy and is not aligned with the complete production footer.
findings.root_cause: Reusable Pencil footer says 'Para saber mais sobre o meu trabalho, visite raigomes.dev'; production correctly uses the required disclaimer, sources and version.
findings.expected_change: Replace Pencil footer copy with the complete non-promotional text and validate wrapping/clipping.

non_failures.detail: Default ultimo-mes is correctly anchored to latest local record 2026-06, hence one chart point jun/26. Selecting Último trimestre/ano changes the series; existing tests cover this.
Production footer renders complete required text in three full-width paragraphs; only the Pencil artifact is stale.

owner_action: Return to Coder/Designer for F-01, F-02, F-04 reference alignment, F-05 and Pencil footer alignment. No production correction was applied by Reviewer.
